description: Recurrence of the class fixed by oracle-review-stale-check-runs-block-merge-20261008. On 2026-10-19/20, PRs 3149, 3156 and 3158 each had a success oracle-verdict status on the current head and green required CI, but a failed oracle-review workflow run on that head ("waiting for the oracle review ... rerun this check after it lands", or "2 unresolved oracle review thread(s)") kept them BLOCKED for about seven hours until they merged without agent action. Agents may not rerun the oracle, so the PR waits on an unnamed manual rerun. Work: determine why the check is not re-evaluated when the verdict lands or threads are resolved (event triggers, head-carry-over runs), and make the check converge without a manual rerun. Guardrail: no stand-in path and no weaker gate.
